common.title: Labour Displacement Wave
common.line: Measurable job losses attributed to AI in named sectors, with the graduate market worst hit: entry-level positions in law, accountancy, software, customer operations and administration are not replaced.

notable.title: Taiwan Blockade
notable.line: A quarantine or blockade halts advanced semiconductor exports.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Fallback siting referendums
notable.line: Municipal referendums in several member states force votes to ban guarded backup-power depots and manual-fallback infrastructure from residential areas, pitting resilience siting against local anti-AI hostility.

notable.title: Lifeline predation
notable.line: Coordinated fuel-theft and generator resale network is exposed spanning three member states, turning fallback sabotage from protest vandalism into organized black-market predation on lifeline stocks.

notable.title: Repair convoy blockades
notable.line: Coordinated anti-AI groups escalate from sabotaging backup stores to physically blocking guarded grid repair convoys, forcing police escorts and delaying restoration drills.
